BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to drug trafficking; adding a new section tochapter 69.50 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 69.50 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person is guilty of drug trafficking if he or she transfersdrugs that are in violation of this chapter across state lines or outof the United States and as a result he or she: (a) Knowingly or intentionally imports or exports a controlledsubstance in violation of this chapter; (b) Knowingly or intentionally brings or possesses on board avessel, aircraft, or vehicle a controlled substance in violation ofthis chapter; or (c) Manufactures, possesses with intent to deliver, or delivers acontrolled substance in violation this chapter. (2) Notwithstanding any other provision of law, a person convictedof a violation of subsection (1) of this section shall be sentenced toa term of total confinement of not less than one hundred twenty months, p. 1 HB 2628or two hundred forty months if the case involves death or seriousbodily injury as a result from the use of such substance, if theoffense involves: (a) One kilogram or more of a mixture or substance containing adetectable amount of heroin; (b) Five kilograms or more of a mixture or substance containing adetectable amount of: (i) Coca leaves, except coca leaves and extracts of coca leavesfrom which cocaine, ecgonine, and derivatives of ecgonine or theirsalts have been removed; (ii) Cocaine, its salts, optical and geometric isomers, and saltsor isomers; (iii) Ecgonine, its derivatives, their salts, isomers, and salts ofisomers; or (iv) Any compound, mixture, or preparation which contains anyquantity of any of the substances referred to in (b)(i) through (iii)of this subsection; (c) Fifty grams or more of a mixture or substance described in (b)of this subsection which contains cocaine base; (d) One hundred grams or more of phencyclidine (PCP) or onekilogram or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectableamount of phencyclidine (PCP); (e) Ten grams or more of a mixture or substance containing adetectable amount of lysergic acid diethylamide; (f) Four hundred grams or more of a mixture or substance containinga detectable amount of NphenylN[1(2phenylethyl)4piperidinyl]propanamide or one hundred grams or more of a mixture or substancecontaining a detectable amount of any analogue of NphenylN[1(2phenylethyl)4piperidinyl] propanamide; (g) One thousand kilograms or more of a mixture or substancecontaining a detectable amount of marihuana; or (h) Fifty grams or more of methamphetamine, its salts, isomers, andsalts of its isomers, or five hundred grams or more of a mixture orsubstance containing a detectable amount of methamphetamine, its salts,isomers, or salts of its isomers. (3) Notwithstanding any other provision of law, for an offenderwith one prior conviction for an offense under subsection (2) of this HB 2628 p. 2 section, such person shall be sentenced to a term of total confinementof not less than two hundred forty months, or life imprisonment ifdeath or serious bodily injury results from the use of such substance. (4) All mandatory minimum terms of total confinement provided inthis section shall be in addition to all other financial penalties orfines provided by law. (5) A minimum term of total confinement imposed under this sectionmay not be varied or modified under RCW 9.94A.535.
